description: Defines data structures, enums, and constants related to positioning, measurement, and configuration in a 5G NR RAN context, including geographical position, SSB properties, timing, and signal references.

classes.name: ssb_burst_position_t
classes.description: Represents the position of an SSB burst with a bitmap and type.

classes.name: ng_ran_access_point_position_t
classes.description: Represents the estimated geographical position of a cell/TP antenna.

classes.name: ssb_info_item_t
classes.description: Contains configuration and PCI number for an SSB info item.

classes.name: ssb_info_t
classes.description: Holds a list of SSB info items.

classes.name: ssb_t
classes.description: Represents an SSB with PCI number and optional index.

classes.name: time_stamp_slot_idx_t
classes.description: Represents a slot index with a specific type and value.

classes.name: time_stamp_t
classes.description: Timestamp with system frame number, slot index, and optional measurement time.

classes.name: dl_prs_t
classes.description: Represents downlink PRS identification and resource set.

classes.name: spatial_relation_info_t
classes.description: Contains reference signals for spatial relation information.

classes.name: active_ul_bwp_t
classes.description: Represents active uplink bandwidth part configuration.

classes.name: srs_carrier_list_item_t
classes.description: Details about an SRS carrier list item including point A, bandwidth, and configuration.

classes.name: srs_configuration_t
classes.description: Holds a list of SRS carrier list items.

classes.name: trp_tx_teg_info_t
classes.description: Contains TEG ID and timing error margin for TRP transmission.
